## `searchForWorkspaceRoot`

**Type Signature:**

```ts
function searchForWorkspaceRoot(
  current: string,
  root = searchForPackageRoot(current),
): string
```

**Related:** [server.fs.allow](/config/server-options.md#server-fs-allow)

Search for the root of the potential workspace if it meets the following conditions, otherwise it would fallback to `root`:

- contains `workspaces` field in `package.json`
- contains one of the following file
  - `lerna.json`
  - `pnpm-workspace.yaml`

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).

a.quote: Search for the root of the potential workspace if it meets the following conditions, otherwise it would fallback to `root`:

b.quote:
A valid workspace met the following conditions, otherwise will fall back to the [project root](/guide/#index-html-and-project-root).

- contains `workspaces` field in `package.json`
- contains one of the following file
  - `lerna.json`
  - `pnpm-workspace.yaml`

Accepts a path to specify the custom workspace root.
